name: com.dynamicdialog
description: Rule-database driven contextual dialog (after Elan Ruskin's GDC 2012 talk). Characters query a flat table of world facts; the most specific matching rule wins, can write facts back to memory, and can trigger followup concepts on other characters.

samples.description: The smallest Dynamic Dialog scene: one character, one rule file, and a speech bubble. Start here. Needs uGUI and TextMeshPro (installed in new projects by default).

Two robots wander a room and talk about what they see: sightings, a running gag, conversations, replies from whoever is in earshot, idle chatter, and danger interrupting a conversation. All lines are in RobotBanter.dlg; edit it while playing.

A playable clinic courtyard with five characters, three fetch quests and pigeons: talking, seeing, areas, pick-ups, memory, game events (do), fact changes and speech bubbles. Kenney CC0 art. Any render pipeline; Input System or Input Manager. Needs uGUI and TextMeshPro.

The speech bubble and subtitle bar presenters side by side, a restyled bubble (prefab variant), and a custom presenter (a chat log) built on IDialogPresenter. Switch between them with 1-4. Needs uGUI and TextMeshPro.
